# CASE py_raw_loop_async_comprehension expect=fire
async def collect(items):
    for item in items:
        consume([row async for row in stream(item)])


# CASE py_inorder_async_comprehension expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), [row async for row in stream(item)])


# CASE py_inorder_async_genexp expect=fire
async def in_order(items, step, *, reason):
    for item in items:
        consume(await step(item), sum([x async for x in stream(item)]))


# CASE py_mwc_async_comprehension expect=fire
async def map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation):
    for offset in range(0, len(items), width):
        log(
            await asyncio.gather(
                *(operation(item) for item in items[offset : offset + width])
            ),
            [r async for r in stream(offset)],
        )
